title: Nine Names and One Job
subtitle: 求职与申请 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：applicant　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 applicant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 my mother was ① an applicant for a job she did not want, and she said that was the only kind she was ever good at. The ② applicant, meaning the person and not the form, is nine parts hope and one part paper; an applicant, my father said, is somebody who has agreed to be counted. She said the counting was the part she minded, not the refusing.

There were ③ nine applicants and one job, and the list was pinned to a door for four days. Every ④ applicant on that list had written the same sentence in the same place, and the manager said that was the only thing he ever learned from reading them; an applicant, my mother said, is a person who has been asked to sound like everybody else. The manager said he could tell the honest ones by the handwriting, and she said he could not.

My uncle had been  an applicant nine times by 1979 and had stopped counting, which he said was the trick. The ⑤ applicant, meaning the idea and not the person, is the only thing in an office that everybody pities and nobody remembers; an applicant, he said, is a number that has agreed to wait. He said the waiting was nine-tenths of it and the answering was the rest.

By the Thursday the ⑥ applicant list had been cut to two, and my mother said the cutting was the whole of the work. The successful ⑦ applicant, they wrote in March, would hear within nine days; an applicant, my father said, is the only person who is told the truth last.

The  applicant she remembered was a woman in a blue coat who had come nine hundred miles and was not on the list at all. An ⑧ applicant, my mother said in 1990, is somebody who has agreed to be judged by a stranger on a Tuesday; every applicant, she said, knows the answer before the letter comes.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 申请人；求职者（一个人）
B. n. 申请人（指人本身，而非那张表格）
D. n. （复数）申请人；求职者们
E. n. 申请人（抽象概念；这种身份）
F. 固定搭配：a successful applicant 被录用的申请人
G. 固定搭配：an applicant for a job 求职者
H. n. 申请人（泛指这类人）

items.q: The applicant, meaning the person and not the form
An applicant, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: an applicant for a job 意为“求职者”，1986 年母亲成了一份她并不想要的工作的求职者。
applicant 指“人本身，而非那张表格”，申请人是九分希望加一分纸。
applicants 为复数，意为“求职者们”，九个申请人争一份工作，名单在门上钉了四天。
applicant 意为“申请人、求职者”，名单上每一个申请人都在同一个地方写了同一句话。
applicant 为抽象概念，指“申请人这种身份”，它是办公室里人人都同情、却没人记得的东西。
applicant 作定语，意为“申请人的”，到星期四那份申请人名单被砍到两个。
a successful applicant 意为“被录用的申请人”，信上写着被录用者将在九天内收到通知。
applicant 泛指“申请人这类人”，她说申请人就是答应让一个陌生人在星期二评判自己的人。
